name: informed_flow
detail: UW options flow; no edge at 1/3/5/10d after overlap + multiple-comparison correction

name: mechanical_calendar_flow
detail: turn-of-month, rebalance-reversal, post-OpEx; all 3 null after Bonferroni

name: momentum_reversal_equity
detail: long-side excess ~+29%/yr but survivorship-inflated; breaks even ~50bps

name: variance_risk_premium
hypothesis: Implied volatility systematically exceeds subsequent realized volatility (forward-aligned), so short-premium/short-vol expressions earn a positive variance risk premium large enough to clear option costs after the magnitude screen. Options-NATIVE (no directional prediction). Tested on UW forward-aligned iv-vs-rv history.
prereg_notes: Unit of inference = calendar MONTH cross-sectional mean VRP (handles 30d-window overlap + market-wide vol correlation). Sign-flip permutation. Magnitude: VRP vol pts -> premium bps via ATM-straddle vega approx vs option round-trip cost. Tail MUST be reported (VRP has negative skew; INTC in the scan realized -8.2 vol pts). Look-ahead: UW RV is forward-aligned + only completed windows; guard urv_date<today anyway. Survivorship: vol series are for CURRENT names -> a positive result is an UPPER bound.

name: variance_risk_premium
detail: UNCONDITIONAL VRP: 50/60 names positive (real, matches literature), mean +1.07 vol pts, but p=0.135 on only 12 monthly units (low power) AND ~180bps premium edge < 600bps cost hurdle. Negative skew -0.67, 25% neg months. Fails significance AND magnitude as a naive short-premium trade. Next: CONDITIONAL VRP (sell only when IV rich).

name: conditional_vrp_rich_iv
hypothesis: The variance risk premium, captured SELECTIVELY only when implied vol is rich (high trailing IV rank) and away from earnings, is large enough to clear ATM-straddle round-trip cost after fees — a tradeable options-native edge. Sell 30d ATM premium on high-IV-rank, non-earnings days.
prereg_notes: Causal TRAILING IV-rank (252d) — NOT full-sample. Exclude entries with an earnings report inside the forward window (earnings VRP is a separate trade + is the tail). Outcome = forward-aligned VRP (completed windows only). Edge_bps ~= 0.5*(IV-RV)/IV*1e4 (ATM straddle vega/premium). Report NET at cost in {100,200,300}bps + BREAK-EVEN cost. Monthly cohort sign-flip inference (overlap+market-corr safe); LOW power after conditioning — say so. Tail (worst month, %neg, skew) mandatory. DUAL-SOURCE realized (UW + TS). Test tercile AND decile thresholds. Survivorship: current names -> UPPER bound.

name: conditional_vrp_rich_iv
detail: FIRST candidate to clear the magnitude screen NET of cost. Sell 30d ATM premium on high-IV-rank (causal trailing), non-earnings days. Tercile: gross ~299bps (UW) / 437bps (TS dual-source), low-IV ~0 (lift +310bps causal), NET +149bps at realistic 150bps straddle cost, break-even 299bps, gross Sharpe 1.75. NOT significant (p=0.14, only 11 monthly units = underpowered). Negative skew -0.99, worst month Jan2026 -989bps (vol-spike tail), 27% net-neg months. Needs: more data for power, term-structure/regime filter for the tail. Cost-aware selection is what makes 150bps realistic.

name: conditional_vrp_rich_iv
detail: UNIVERSE EXPANSION 60->201 names WEAKENED it: unconditional VRP +1.07->+0.32 vol pts (p 0.14->0.75); conditional net@150bps +149bps->-1.7bps, verdict PROMISING->NOT_YET_AN_EDGE. The +149bps was a most-liquid-mega-cap effect; curated-60 flattered it via favorable sample. UW-TS realized divergence GREW on broad universe (UW +0.002 vs TS +0.020) = estimator noise on less-liquid names. HONEST READ: any tradeable VRP is concentrated in the very-most-liquid large-caps/ETFs, is modest even there, and does not generalize. Not dead (154/200 still positive) but much weaker than first read. Broad universe is the unbiased test.

name: conditional_vrp_rich_iv
detail: Attempted a dual-source data-quality gate (require UW/TS realized vol to agree) to rescue the broad-universe collapse. REJECTED as selection bias: the gate drops exactly the vol-SPIKE observations (dropped-obs mean edge -2675bps, realized vol 0.70; rich-IV dropped -4066bps) = the vol-sellers catastrophic losses. Censoring the tail of a RISK premium fakes an edge. Decomposition showed the apparent rescue was (a) tail-censoring gate + (b) averaging in TS close-to-close which underestimates vol/inflates VRP. HONEST FINAL: conditional VRP on 201-name unbiased universe with UW realized (tail incl) = net -1.7bps @150, p=0.47, break-even. NOT a tradeable edge. Earlier 60-name +149bps was favorable sample selection. Forward panel remains the only clean arbiter.

name: dealer_gamma_regime_vol
hypothesis: Dealer gamma exposure (UW greek-exposure, backtestable ~1yr) predicts forward realized vol -> a CAUSAL entry filter to sell premium only when dealers are long gamma (vol suppressed) and avoid the short-gamma vol-spike tail.
prereg_notes: Causal (gamma known at entry). Tercile split on net dealer gamma (call_gamma+put_gamma), forward realized vol + VRP as outcome, tail via 95th pct realized. Must SEPARATE the tail to be useful.

name: dealer_gamma_regime_vol
detail: 1848 obs, 12 names. Low vs high dealer-gamma tercile: fwd realized 0.316 vs 0.299 (1.7 vol pt, trivial); 95th-pct realized IDENTICAL 0.582 vs 0.600 -> gamma gives NO tail protection. VRP higher in LOW gamma (opposite thesis; IV elevated there). Not a usable regime filter for vol-selling. Could have been cherry-picked into a fake low-gamma edge but the tail is the same.

name: dispersion_correlation_premium
hypothesis: Index (SPY) implied vol is systematically rich vs the vol its constituents realize -> a positive index-minus-single-name VRP (implied correlation premium). Sell index vol / buy single-name vol captures it.
prereg_notes: Backtestable from cached VRP vol data. Per date: SPY_VRP minus avg single-name VRP. Monthly cohort sign-flip. Magnitude vs multi-leg dispersion cost (high). Tail mandatory.

name: dispersion_correlation_premium
detail: STRONGEST finding: VRP is CONCENTRATED in the INDEX/ETFs (SPY VRP +2.67 vol pts) not single names (~+0.15). Dispersion premium +2.66 vol pts, p=0.025, 82% positive months, worst -0.046. This is the documented index variance / correlation risk premium (index buyers overpay for crash protection). Explains why broad-universe VRP looked break-even: single names (VRP~0) diluted the ETFs. TRADEABLE expression = defined-risk premium selling on ETFs/INDEX (NOT full dispersion - too many legs for a 10k book). BUT it IS the crash risk premium: the tail is a correlated market crash (bounded per-trade by wings, across book by the portfolio cap). Still 11 monthly units (underpowered). This refines the short-premium engine: focus on ETFs, drop single-name mega-caps (VRP~0, pure cost).

name: dispersion_correlation_premium
detail: POWER firmed via moving-block bootstrap (block=21d) on daily index-basket VRP: 95pct CI [+1.48,+3.66] vol pts EXCLUDES 0, one-sided bootstrap p~0, block t-stat 5.2. Much stronger than the monthly p=0.025. Regime test: NO clean tail separation - stressed regime (high trailing RV) has HIGHER VRP (+0.039 vs calm +0.015, vol mean-reverts) but marginally worse tail; premium and tail move together (it IS a risk premium). IRREDUCIBLE CAVEAT: ~1yr data likely contains NO major crash, so the bootstrap resamples a crash-free year and UNDERSTATES the left tail - the backtest structurally cannot show the crash. Hence defined-risk (wings + portfolio cap) is non-negotiable. Real exploits: power(done), breadth/diversification of idiosyncratic vol, harvest where IV richest, forward panel as true OOS arbiter.

name: cross_asset_variance_premium
hypothesis: A variance risk premium exists in NON-EQUITY asset classes (rates, credit, oil, dollar) with tails UNCORRELATED to the equity crash -> a diversifying variance-premium harvest that breaks the single-crash concentration of index vol selling.
prereg_notes: Measured VRP + monthly-VRP correlation with SPY across 12 cross-asset ETFs. Keep positive-VRP + low-corr; drop negative-VRP.

name: cross_asset_variance_premium
detail: DIVERSIFYING variance premiums found: TLT/IEF (rates) 16-18% of IV corr 0.23-0.27 w/ SPY; HYG/LQD (credit) 16.8% corr 0.26/-0.07; USO (oil) 14% corr 0.00; UUP (dollar) 19.4% corr -0.22 (partial equity-crash HEDGE). Comparable premium to equity index but INDEPENDENT tails (different risk drivers). GLD/SLV/GDX have NEGATIVE VRP (gold vol UNDERpriced - do NOT sell). Turns the harvest from one correlated equity-crash bet into a diversified basket of independent-tail premiums. CAVEAT: ~1yr, correlations noisy on 11 monthly pts, same crash-understatement; risk-driver logic (rates/credit/oil/fx != equity) is the real basis. Harvest set expanded; cost gate skips illiquid names.

name: dispersion_market_neutral_rv
hypothesis: Dispersion (short index vol / long single-name vol) is a BETTER risk-adjusted edge than outright index vol selling because the market-neutral spread hedges the crash.
prereg_notes: Compare monthly Sharpe + worst-month of outright index VRP vs the dispersion spread.

name: dispersion_market_neutral_rv
detail: Outright index VRP Sharpe 5.67 (worst month -0.0027, 91pct positive) vs dispersion spread Sharpe 2.89 (worst -0.036). Dispersion WORSE in-sample: it adds the single-name legs idiosyncratic-vol noise+cost without a crash to justify the hedge. KEY META-FINDING: the outright Sharpe 5.67 is not an edge, it is the SIGNATURE of selling crash insurance in a crash-free year - it looks like free money until the crash. Every vol-premium edge found is inflated the same way by the ~1yr no-crash sample. Chasing a HIGHER-Sharpe better edge = chasing the mirage. The genuinely better improvements are STRUCTURAL and do NOT inflate the backtest: cross-asset diversification of the tail (done) + defined-risk wings + portfolio cap (done). No demonstrably-better edge exists in this data; there is one family of crash premia, best harvested diversified + defined-risk.

name: term_structure_carry
hypothesis: The vol term-structure SLOPE (back IV - front IV) is a CAUSAL entry signal: steep contango -> forward realized stays low (safe, positive VRP); backwardation -> forward realized spikes (the crash tail). If the slope SEPARATES the tail, term-structure-timed vol selling is a better, crash-aware edge than outright VRP.
prereg_notes: UW historical term-structure per date (now verified backtestable). Slope = mean back(45-100d) IV - mean front(7-20d) IV. Bucket dates by slope tercile; compare forward VRP + 95th-pct forward realized (tail) across buckets. Causal (slope known at entry).

name: term_structure_carry
detail: 580 obs across SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA/XLF, UW historical term structure (now confirmed backtestable). SLOPE as regime filter: backwardation has RICHEST VRP (+0.042 vs steep contango +0.012 - vol mean-reverts, same as vol-level regime) but does NOT separate the tail (95pct fwd realized 0.241 backwardation vs 0.227 steep; steep contango had the WORST single VRP -0.135). Pure roll-down carry = mean slope only +0.008 vol pts = too small for option cost (magnitude fail). NOT a better edge. THIRD confirmation (after vol-level regime + dealer gamma) that NO observable regime signal separates the crash tail: premium is richest in stress but the tail comes regardless. IMPLICATION: the crash tail is IRREDUCIBLE by timing -> can only be bounded STRUCTURALLY (defined-risk wings + portfolio cap, done). Testing this was correct (UW does have the data, per operator challenge); the honest result is null.

name: put_skew_premium
hypothesis: The index variance premium is concentrated in an OVERPRICED PUT SKEW (crash insurance): OTM put IV far exceeds OTM call IV and the realized downside asymmetry. Selling put-side structures captures more premium per unit of defined risk.
prereg_notes: Current per-strike IV (UW option-contracts) vs realized down/up deviation (TS bars) across index basket.

name: put_skew_premium
detail: Equity-index put-call skew +7-12 vol pts (SPY +11.9, QQQ +10.2, DIA +9.7, IWM +9.3) vs realized down-up asymmetry only ~1.4 vol pts -> put skew MASSIVELY overpriced = the crash-insurance premium, the richest part of the whole variance premium. XLE (energy) NOT skewed (2-sided/upside risk). ACTIONABLE: put-side-weighted structures (short put spreads / asymmetric condors selling the put closer to ATM) capture more premium than symmetric condors. TRADEOFF: put-tilt CONCENTRATES crash exposure (you become purely short the downside) - the OPPOSITE of the cross-asset diversification. Balanced play = MODEST asymmetric tilt (put nearer ATM, call further OTM) within defined-risk, not naked short puts. Not a new independent edge - it is the STRUCTURE of the premium already being harvested, made sharper.

name: skew_timing
hypothesis: Put skew mean-reverts, so when it is STEEP (unusually overpriced) the forward put-writing outcome is richer -> harvest MORE premium when skew is rich. A causal timing signal that makes the (defined-risk) put-selling more profitable.
prereg_notes: Historical per-strike IV (UW option-contracts date param, now confirmed). skew=putIV-callIV per date; outcome=putIV - forward realized (put VRP); bucket by skew tercile; compare put-VRP + tail. Causal (skew known at entry).

name: skew_timing
detail: 81 obs SPY/QQQ/IWM, historical per-strike IV. STEEP put skew -> forward put-VRP +0.126 vs MID +0.112 vs FLAT +0.082 (MONOTONIC, ~54pct more premium in steep vs flat). Real, documented skew mean-reversion / sell-fear effect. First regime signal where the PREMIUM ordering is monotonic & clean. ACTIONABLE (more profitable): skew-conditioned harvesting - size UP when put skew is rich, down/skip when flat, within the portfolio cap. HONEST CAVEAT: steep bucket ALSO shows best in-sample tail (worst put-VRP +0.053, no losses) - DO NOT TRUST. Steep skew IS when the market prices a crash; usually wrong (profit) but when right = biggest losses, absent from a crash-free year. Premium enhancement REAL; tail-safety is the crash-free-sample mirage. Keep defined-risk + portfolio cap; use skew for SIZING the premium, never for relaxing the tail bound.
